hypothesis: A retention record that binds raw-byte digests, calibration reference and validity window, frame chain with covariances and an explicit clock is sufficient to supply the acquisition fields of a hardware_measured finding, and every omission is refused.
input_data: Schema fixture with explicit 'SCHEMA FIXTURE - NOT A MEASUREMENT' raw bytes (not retained)
11 refused mutations, one rank-deficient covariance at a 1e6 mm^2 scale with a -1e-8 mm^2 eigenvalue and one with a negative eigenvalue of -1e-3 of its largest
No acquisition: nothing exists to retain
mathematical_model: Record = {raw digests, instrument identity, calibration (applied/not_applied), frame chain links (R, t, C), clock}; identity = SHA-256 of canonical JSON; to_acquisition maps a valid measurement record to device / raw_sha256 (SHA-256 of the raw manifest) / acquired_at / calibration.
numerical_result: 11/11 mutations refused with the expected code; rank-deficient covariance kept (min eigenvalue -1.0e-08 mm^2 against a largest of 1.0e+06 mm^2, 1e+04 times an absolute 1e-12 mm^2 threshold); retained real measurements: 0.
observation_model: No observation: no instrument produced data. The validators read only the declared schema fixture and its mutations.

physical_validation_status.statement: Physical validation requires acquired hardware evidence; none was acquired for this task.

recommended_next_task: Retain the first MFG-FLAT-PLATE-01 acquisition with this schema, then rerun T138, whose pair comparator (compare_pair_distances) compares its marker-pair distances.

uncertainty: Exact: the outcomes are booleans and refusal codes of deterministic validators; the only floating-point quantity is the rounding-level eigenvalue of the rank-deficient covariance.
unresolved_assumptions: No acquisition exists, so no raw measurement, calibration record or frame metadata has been retained: the task stays partial until the first protocol is executed.
Media-type-specific readers (images, point clouds) are not defined; digests cover bytes, not content semantics.
The validators cannot tell whether raw bytes came from an instrument; the runner also requires a hardware probe in the task that cites them.
